titleAr: ابعت طلب لفريق ابدأ ستور من جوه المنتج
titleEn: Send a request to the Ebda Store team from inside the product
screens: every admin page (Contact Ebda Store button, sidebar)
steps: Press Contact Ebda Store in the sidebar, pick a topic, write the message, send
edgeCases: 5 requests per store per day, the sixth answers 429
The row is stored even if the email cannot be sent
Messages go to Ebda staff only, never to customers
